The following events took place in '''3900 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Elsinoré den Tasia]] of [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] sponsored one of [[Gender/Legends|her]] last [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] missions from her world, with three [[Colony ship/Legends|ships]], ''[[Beneficent Tasia]]'', ''[[Constant]]'', and ''[[Mother Vima]]'' departing<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> under the leadership of [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan]],<ref name="Secrets">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> with the blessing of a famous [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. The ships disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] view but landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and began its colonization, with the descendants of the colonists eventually calling themselves the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
*[[Vaner Shan]] runs for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="Revan" />
